notes.title: Day one updates!
notes.content: Fixed a little bug that prevented Spaceship map acchievements unlock.

notes.title: Goodbye Dr Sanchez is out!
notes.content: 🎉 The wait is over! 🎮 Dive into the horror of "Goodbye Dr. Sanchez" TODAY! 😱 Join forces with a partner, explore twisted domains, and outsmart the evil that lurks within. Get ready for cooperative gaming experience. Let the nightmare begin!

notes.title: Release date on June 20th!
notes.content: 🚨 Save the date! 📅 Prepare to face your fears on June 20th as "Goodbye Dr. Sanchez" arrives to terrify you! Team up with a partner in this cooperative horror game, outsmart traps, and survive the twisted domains of Dr. Sanchez.😱

notes.content: The game is now localized to Japanese language!

notes.title: Goodbye Dr Sanchez Available in Spanish!
notes.content: New update! Goodbye Dr Sanchez will be able to be played in Spanish! And stay tuned for more languages coming soon!

notes.title: Goodbye Dr Sanchez present at the Steam Scream Fest!
notes.content: A new demo, developers streams and new content as we celebrate Halloween on the Steam Scream Fest!

notes.title: Thank you all for an excellent Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
We had a great experience at Steam Next Fest and it was thanks to all of you who played our demo, joined our livestreams and interacted with us!
From now on, the demo will be delisted from Steam and we hope to have your support for the October release date!
